metrics_sql.mtr_generation_mix_monthly:
-- Layer 3 · Certified metric. Generation by technology and its share of the month's total.
with by_tech as (
    select
        d.year_month,
        r.technology,
        sum(g.generation_kwh) / 1e6 as generation_gwh
    from {{ ref('fct_generation_by_resource_hourly') }} g
    join {{ ref('dim_resource') }} r using (resource_code)
    join {{ ref('dim_date') }} d using (date_day)
    group by d.year_month, r.technology
)
select
    year_month,
    technology,
    generation_gwh,
    generation_gwh / sum(generation_gwh) over (partition by year_month) as share_of_month
from by_tech
order by year_month, generation_gwh desc
metrics_sql.mtr_hourly_profile:
-- Layer 3 · Certified metric. Average demand and spot price by hour of day, weekdays vs weekends, per year.
select
    d.year,
    d.is_weekend,
    f.hour_of_day,
    avg(f.demand_kwh) / 1e3          as avg_demand_mwh,
    avg(f.spot_price_cop_kwh)        as avg_spot_price_cop_kwh
from {{ ref('fct_system_hourly') }} f
join {{ ref('dim_date') }} d using (date_day)
group by d.year, d.is_weekend, f.hour_of_day
order by d.year, d.is_weekend, f.hour_of_day
metrics_sql.mtr_market_daily:
-- Layer 3 · Certified metric. Daily market summary.
-- spot_price_weighted: hourly spot price weighted by hourly commercial demand (what the market actually paid on average).
select
    f.date_day,
    d.year_month,
    sum(f.demand_kwh) / 1e6                                         as demand_gwh,
    sum(f.generation_kwh) / 1e6                                     as generation_gwh,
    sum(f.spot_price_cop_kwh * f.demand_kwh) / sum(f.demand_kwh)    as spot_price_weighted_cop_kwh,
    avg(f.spot_price_cop_kwh)                                       as spot_price_simple_avg_cop_kwh,
    max(f.spot_price_cop_kwh)                                       as spot_price_max_cop_kwh,
    min(f.spot_price_cop_kwh)                                       as spot_price_min_cop_kwh
from {{ ref('fct_system_hourly') }} f
join {{ ref('dim_date') }} d using (date_day)
group by f.date_day, d.year_month
metrics_sql.mtr_market_monthly:
-- Layer 3 · Certified metric. Monthly market and hydrology.
-- inflows_vs_historical: inflows as a share of their historical mean (below 1 = drier than usual).
-- reservoir_share_end_of_month: useful reservoir volume on the last day with data in the month.
with market as (
    select
        d.year_month,
        sum(f.demand_kwh) / 1e6                                      as demand_gwh,
        sum(f.spot_price_cop_kwh * f.demand_kwh) / sum(f.demand_kwh) as spot_price_weighted_cop_kwh,
        max(f.spot_price_cop_kwh)                                    as spot_price_max_cop_kwh,
        count(distinct f.date_day)                                   as days_with_data
    from {{ ref('fct_system_hourly') }} f
    join {{ ref('dim_date') }} d using (date_day)
    group by d.year_month
),
hydro as (
    select
        strftime(date_day, '%Y-%m')                                  as year_month,
        sum(inflows_kwh) / sum(inflows_historical_mean_kwh)          as inflows_vs_historical,
        arg_max(reservoir_useful_volume_share, date_day)             as reservoir_share_end_of_month,
        min(reservoir_useful_volume_share)                           as reservoir_share_min
    from {{ ref('fct_hydrology_daily') }}
    group by 1
)
select m.*, h.inflows_vs_historical, h.reservoir_share_end_of_month, h.reservoir_share_min
from market m
left join hydro h using (year_month)
order by year_month
